findings.message: A.5.32 is excluded without a justification.
EV-038 supports control CTL-DLP-01, which is not defined.
CSF2 'PR.AC-7' is not in the catalog: PR.AC is a CSF 1.1 category that CSF 2.0 removed; remap to the 2.0 subcategory.
CIS8 '5.7' is not in the catalog: CIS Control 5 has safeguards 5.1-5.6 in v8.1.
ISO27001 '8.9' is not in the catalog: clause 8.9 does not exist; did you mean Annex A control A.8.9?
ISO27001 'A.12.4.1' is not in the catalog: looks like ISO/IEC 27001:2013 numbering; map it to the 2022 control.
Control CTL-LEG-01 has no evidence in the register.
Control CTL-LEG-01 has no owner; nobody is accountable for its evidence.
Control CTL-LEG-01 maps to no framework requirement; its testing earns no credit.
A.7.4 is excluded from scope, yet a fully mapped control operates effectively. Check the justification (ISO 27001 6.1.3 d).
EV-030 is dated 2026-11-20, after the assessment date.
CTL-VUL-01 -> CIS8 7.1 already mapped on line 151.
